schema.title: REVOLT Classic
schema.description: Settings for a prepared REVOLT Classic HIL plant.

pupil_resolution.title: Pupil resolution (pixels)
pupil_resolution.description: Pixels across the common square pupil sampling. Changing sampling requires rebuilding the plant and corresponding calibration; detector dimensions stay fixed.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Deformable-mirror response implementation. Changing it requires rebuilding the plant and corresponding calibration.

atmosphere.title: Atmosphere
atmosphere.description: Multilayer turbulence parameters. All layer arrays must have the same nonzero length. AOS validates physical values when rebuilding the plant.

reference_wavelength_m.title: Reference wavelength (m)
reference_wavelength_m.description: Wavelength defining the atmosphere Fried parameter and phase-to-OPD conversion, independently of the guide-source or science-source wavelength. Stored in metres; displayed in nanometres.

wind_speed.title: Layer wind speeds (m/s)
wind_speed.description: Frozen-flow wind speed of each layer, in layer order.

fractional_cn2.title: Layer turbulence fractions (dimensionless)
fractional_cn2.description: Nonnegative fractions of integrated Cn² in layer order. Fractions must sum to one.

altitude.title: Layer altitudes (m)
altitude.description: Altitude of each turbulence layer, in layer order.

layer_ids.title: Layer IDs
layer_ids.description: Unique stochastic identities in layer order, used with the seed for reproducible atmosphere generation.

r0.title: Fried parameter r0 (m)
r0.description: Fried parameter at the reference wavelength. Kolmogorov seeing FWHM is approximately 0.98 × reference_wavelength_m / r0 radians (multiply by 206265 for arcseconds); finite outer scale changes that relation.

L0.title: Outer scale L0 (m)
L0.description: Finite von Kármán turbulence outer scale.

wind_direction_deg.title: Layer wind directions (degrees)
wind_direction_deg.description: Wind-velocity direction in each layer: x = speed × cosd(direction), y = speed × sind(direction).

rng_seed.title: RNG seed
rng_seed.description: Nonnegative seed for deterministic atmosphere generation.
